title: The New Neighbour
story: Aisha saw boxes in the hall on Saturday morning. A new neighbour was moving into the empty flat. His name was Sam. He carried a lamp, a suitcase, and a plant with long leaves. The plant nearly fell when he opened his door. Aisha held the door and took the plant. Sam thanked her and said he did not know anyone in the building yet. Aisha told him her name and the number of her flat. She also told him that the bins were behind the back door. Sam wrote it in a small notebook. Later she brought him a cup of tea and two biscuits. They stood in the hall because his chairs were still in the van. Sam said he worked at the hospital and started early. Aisha said the street was quiet at night. Before she left, she pointed to the shelf where people left parcels. Sam put his spare key in a drawer, not under the mat. He said he would say hello when he saw her on the stairs. Aisha went home glad that the empty flat was no longer empty. She washed the two cups and left them on the rack. It felt good to know the name of the person next door.
